newsitem.title: FINLAND: AAMULEHTI I-SHARE TO BOURSE LIST DEC 12.
newsitem.headline: AAMULEHTI I-SHARE TO BOURSE LIST DEC 12.

text.p: The series I share of Finnish media group Aamulehti Oy will start trading on the main list of the Helsinki Stock Exchange and leave the Brokers' list on December 12, the Helsinki bourse said in a statement.

The last day of trading for Aamulehti I on the Brokers' list is December 11. The share was last traded on December 5 when it closed at a year-high 150.00 markka. Its year-low is 99.00 markka. On the bourse, Aamulehti I will be quoted among other industry shares.
Aamulehti's series II share has been quoted on the main list since June 13, 1994.
